maker.name: Outemu
maker.about: Outemu is the switch brand of Dongguan Gaote Electronics Co., Ltd. (东莞市高特电子有限公司) in Tangxia, Dongguan, which also makes micro switches, tact switches and connectors. Gaote dates its founding to December 2004.

switches.name: Cream Blue
switches.notes: Gaote lists two cream blue models (PG152Q65 and PG152Q67); the retail listing does not say which.

switches.name: Cream Yellow (Silent)
switches.notes: Gaote also lists a non-silent cream yellow (PG152Y65); the retail listing sold as Cream Yellow is the silent tactile one.

switches.name: Dustproof Black
switches.notes: Gaote's catalog lists only a dustproof plug-in black (PG150B76X); Milktooth marks this listing discontinued.

switches.name: Outemu Black

reviews.verdict: Heavier linear for firm typists and gaming; budget switch with more wobble and a shorter rated life than Cherry MX.

sources.title: Switch and Click: Outemu Switches: Are they Good?

switches.notes: Gaote lists "+" (PG150B61) and dustproof plug-in (PG150B76X) versions; the retail listing does not say which.

switches.name: Outemu Blue

reviews.verdict: The reviewer rates Blue as Outemu's best switch: loud clicky feedback suited to typing, less suited to fast gaming or offices.

sources.title: Switch and Click: Outemu Switches: Are they Good?

switches.notes: Gaote calls this colour cyan (青轴) and lists "+" (PG150Q61), dustproof (PG150Q65) and dustproof plug-in (PG150Q76X) versions; the retail listing does not say which.

switches.name: Outemu Brown

reviews.verdict: Light tactile bump that works for typing and casual gaming; the reviewer prefers other makers for tactile switches.

sources.title: Switch and Click: Outemu Switches: Are they Good?

switches.notes: Gaote lists "+" (PG150T61), dustproof (PG150T65) and dustproof plug-in (PG150T76X) versions; the retail listing does not say which.

switches.name: Outemu Gold
switches.notes: Gaote lists a "+" golden switch (PG150U61); the retail listing does not give a model number.

switches.name: Outemu Red

reviews.verdict: Light linear suited to gaming and quiet offices, but budget build with some rattle; the reviewer prefers other makers for linears.

sources.title: Switch and Click: Outemu Switches: Are they Good?

switches.notes: Gaote lists the red in "+" (PG150R61), dustproof (PG150R65) and dustproof plug-in (PG150R76X) versions; the retail listing used for specs does not say which.

switches.name: Outemu Silver
switches.notes: Gaote lists a dustproof silver (PG150A60) and a "+" silver (PG150A61); the retail listing does not say which.
